title: Resolution urging Congress to let SNAP buy hot foods
summary: This resolution calls on Congress to pass, and the President to sign, the federal Hot Foods Act of 2025, which would let SNAP benefits be used to buy hot foods or ready-to-eat hot food products. Currently federal law excludes hot foods from SNAP-eligible purchases. The Council argues this change would help food-insecure households facing barriers like lack of time, disability, or lack of cooking equipment.
